text.text: The database connection pool of billing-api recycles idle connections after 900 s, later than the DBProxy's idle client timeout of 600 s: the proxy closed connections the pool still used, and requests on them failed with 504s.

Corrective actions: 2 to do, 3 in all
• Open · INC-2024-0312/3 · Add an automatic check comparing the proxy's idle timeout with the pool's recycling at each deployment.
• Done · INC-2024-0312/1 · Write a dedicated runbook for the proxy and pool timeouts.
• Proposed · <review>-1 · Set the pool's idle recycling of billing-api below the DBProxy's idle client timeout.
